description: This file defines the 'ViewRelationships' class, a PHP class responsible for handling the display and processing of relationship views in the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM. It manages the rendering of relationships in the UI, handles AJAX interactions, and integrates with other ModuleBuilder parts.

classes.name: ViewRelationships
classes.description: A PHP class that manages the display and AJAX handling of module relationships within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder. It extends SugarView and provides methods for rendering the relationships interface and encoding relationship data for front-end display.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of title parameters for the module, used in the UI header.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that handles the rendering of the relationships view, including setting up Smarty templates, AJAX responses, and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: getAjaxRelationships
methods.description: Processes relationship objects to produce a JSON-ready array of relationship data, translating types and handling custom relationships.

methods.name: fetchTemplate
methods.description: Overrides the fetchTemplate method from SugarView to fetch Smarty templates with custom file path resolution.
